info.name: BugLens — Defect Quality Checker API
info.description:
REST API for the BugLens defect quality checker. Endpoints cover validation, scoring, and full analysis. The collection ships with a strong / mediocre / failing sample so you can demo each tier in seconds.

Import instructions: Postman → File → Import → select this file. Set the `baseUrl` variable to `http://127.0.0.1:8001` (or your deployed host).

{
  "title": "Checkout total wrong when applying 10% coupon on cart > 5 items",
  "description": "When a cart has 5 or more items and a 10% coupon is applied, the displayed total is incorrect by a few cents. Reproduced on staging and production.",
  "steps_to_reproduce": "1. Add 6 items to cart (mix of SKUs)\n2. Apply coupon code 'WELCOME10'\n3. View cart total",
  "expected_result": "Total should be (subtotal × 0.90) rounded to 2 decimal places",
  "actual_result": "Total is (subtotal × 0.90) − 0.03, off by 3 cents on every order",
  "environment": "Chrome 124 on Windows 11",
  "severity": "major"
}

{
  "title": "Login returns 500 on Safari 17 with valid credentials",
  "description": "When a user signs in on Safari 17.4 (macOS 14.4), the server returns 500 instead of redirecting to the dashboard. Affects ~30% of macOS users in the last 24h based on Datadog error spike.",
  "steps_to_reproduce": "1. Open https://app.example.com/login in Safari 17.4\n2. Enter a valid test email and password\n3. Click the 'Sign in' button\n4. Observe the response",
  "expected_result": "User is authenticated, session cookie is set, and the page redirects to /dashboard within 2 seconds.",
  "actual_result": "Server responds with HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'. Safari console shows a CORS preflight failure for /api/v1/auth.",
  "environment": "macOS 14.4 · Safari 17.4 · app build 2.3.1 · account role: standard user",
  "severity": "critical"
}
